title: Challenge 1 Quiz - Creating Content with AI

questions.question: What is the main purpose of Generative AI?
options: To create new content such as text, images and videos

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of written content that AI can generate?
What is a prompt?
options: An instruction or question given to an AI system

questions.question: Which prompt is more effective?
options: Write a professional LinkedIn post promoting an AI course for entrepreneurs.

questions.question: Why should you specify the target audience in your prompt?
options: To help AI generate more relevant content
To make the AI work slower

questions.question: What is a hook in social media content?
options: An opening statement that captures attention

questions.question: What is the purpose of a Call to Action (CTA)?
options: To tell the audience what to do next

questions.question: Which practice usually produces better blog articles with AI?
options: Generating an outline before expanding the article
Copying the first AI response immediately

questions.question: Why should AI-generated content be reviewed before publishing?
options: To verify accuracy and improve quality
Because AI always writes in another language
There is no need to review it

questions.question: Which statement best describes the role of AI in content creation?
options: AI should replace human creativity completely.
AI is a helpful assistant, but humans should review and improve the final content.
AI should never be used for writing.
